**Finding submitted: ASSIGN — deviation (fallback target), confidence 0.82.**

- **What the contract does:** Section 18.9 (p0785) is mutual — either Party may assign without consent to an entity acquiring substantially all of its business or assets (merger, acquisition or otherwise), with the acquirer's written assumption delivered to the non-assigning Party; all other Third Party assignments require the other Party's written consent. The Affiliate route (p0786) also requires prior written consent, so it does not conflict with the "other assignments require consent" element.
- **Change of control:** No exit or re-pricing right runs against us. Section 18.10 (p0788) imposes only firewall procedures on a Change in Control of **Array**, and Section 4.5(b) (p0322) merely terminates a restriction on Array. Nothing triggers on an Ono Change in Control, so that element is not breached.
- **Gap cured:** Consent to non-successor assignments was at absolute discretion. One surgical insertion adds "(which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed)" — mirroring the standard already used for Affiliate assignments in the same Section — bringing the clause to the fallback without rewriting it into the asymmetric preferred form.
